title: GrpcConfig
description:
Configuration for the gRPC transport.

gRPC is the default transport for `wyrd-client`. The server-side endpoint is the Wyrd ingest gateway or any compatible tonic-based receiver.

auth.description: Optional bearer token or mTLS identity reference.

endpoint.description: gRPC server endpoint. Must be `http://host:port` or `https://host:port`.

timeout_ms.description: Per-call timeout in milliseconds. Must be at least 1.

SecretRef.description:
Pointer into the Wyrd runtime secret store.

The `Inline` variant is compiled only for `cfg(test)` inside `wyrd-spec` or when the `test-utils` feature is enabled. Public schema goldens are generated without `test-utils`, so `inline` is absent from production schemas.

name.description: Environment variable name. Must be non-empty when resolved.

oneOf.description: Local filesystem path to a file containing the secret value.

path.description: File path. Must be non-empty when resolved.

oneOf.description: Backend-agnostic key in an external secret manager.

key.description: Secret-manager key path. Interpretation is backend-specific.

TlsConfig.description: TLS configuration for a transport connection.

client_key.description: PEM-encoded client private key for mTLS.

insecure_skip_verify.description: Disable peer certificate verification. Defaults to `false`.

server_name_override.description: Override the server name used in SNI and certificate verification.
